integrity: The Nijenhuis equations are reconstructed directly from the multiplication table rather than assumed from the source. The automorphism group and conjugation action are derived independently from the generator e1. Finite-field orbit counts are proved from the action and replayed by exhaustive enumeration in four prime fields.
scientific_limitations: The orbit classification is for the three-dimensional null-filiform algebra A2, not every algebra in the 2021 classification.
The raw four-parameter Nijenhuis family is prior work; the assessed new content is the automorphism quotient, exceptional symmetry stratum, and finite-field orbit count.
A specialized or unindexed source may contain an equivalent quotient calculation.
title: Automorphism orbits of Nijenhuis operators on the three-dimensional null-filiform algebra
